column5: FIGMA PARITY NEAR-COMPLETE: 15 of 22 frames carry a `match` visual verdict (Pre Game 9069-959, Full Game 9069-859 plus its Adjusted Slider / Roll Over / Win Chance / Multiplier states, Auto 9062-17693, Auto No Infinity 9069-1068, Auto Advanced Displayed 9065-1579 and Extended 9062-16886, tablet 9003-44223, mobile 9003-44847), routed at /play/dice via DicePage + DicePageSections. ★ 2026-08-05 - THE MULTIPLIER DIVERGENCE IS CLOSED AND VERIFIED AGAINST THE DEPLOYED RAIL, NOT AGAINST SOURCE. The client quotes 95/winChance (diceOdds.ts:21 RTP_PERCENT=95, max 9500x at the 0.01% floor) and the rules sheet says 9500x (GameRulesButton.tsx:466). The POINTS rail was paying 99/winChance until 7aa07b6d8 replaced it with DICE_RTP_PERCENT=95 (points-game/index.ts:5542-5545); that commit landed 2026-08-04T22:47Z and points-game v99 deployed 2026-08-05T01:36Z, so the fix is LIVE. Confirmed from production points_game_rounds: threshold 5050 `over` (49.49% chance), stake 10 -> payout 19, i.e. 1.90x = 95/49.49. The old 1%-edge rail would have paid 20. Nothing is left to re-render here; the frames themselves quote 1.9800 beside a 50% win chance, which is the OLD 1%-edge number and is a designer placeholder the panel deliberately does not reproduce - it prints the multiplier the amount was computed from, off real state. ★ 9069-1141 Desktop First Roll IS reachable and IS built - the earlier `never exercised` note was a local zero-POINTS balance, not a code gap: production has 415 settled dice rounds, latest 2026-08-05T03:21Z. Exercising the state DID surface one real defect, now fixed: the recent-roll pill row was `justify-between`, which parks a LONE pill at the LEFT edge, while this frame - the only one in the file with a determinate pill count - pins the single post-roll pill to the RIGHT (x=858 of the 954 panel). DiceGame.tsx:1468 is now `flex-row-reverse justify-between`, so a partial row anchors right and the newest roll sits rightmost while the verified 12-pill even spread (9069-1343) is unchanged. ★ 9003-44542 Tablet Alt is DECLINED, not deferred, and should not be built. It is the rival of 9003-44223 at the identical 768x1024 breakpoint, route and pre-game state - only one can ever render - and it is not a second tablet design: its children are the MOBILE composition re-parented into the tablet shell (9088-1539 is literally named `Mobile`, 422x422, and 9003-44639 `Frame 270` is the 422x322 mobile bet panel), centred in the 708 bento with the board letterboxed to 422. Building it would replace the verified full-width tablet board with a padded mobile one. Same call, same grounds, as Mines 9003-110110 tablet A. The practice-mode toggle drawn in 9003-43516 (and repeated in both tablet frames) is a PERMANENT deliberate divergence - no game gets Practice/Fun/Demo; POINTS is the free-play path. The 7 unverified ids are Figma artifact layers (CTA/button, card, a misfiled Home frame 2736-25840) with no UI to build, and the remaining 13 never-seen ids are confirmed artifact layers - no unbuilt surface is hiding in this file. Stays `partial` only because the two frames touched this pass (9069-1141, and 9069-859's pill row by extension) have not been re-screenshotted since the change. ★ 2026-08-05 ROUTE VERIFIED IN A BROWSER. /play/dice mounts at 1440 with the full column and no mount errors (console noise is the same environmental CORS/401/wss-403 set as the other game routes). The panel quotes 'Potential Profit: (1.92x)' at the default win chance, which is 95/49.5 - the corrected 5%-edge rail (DICE_RTP_PERCENT = 95, points-game:5542), NOT the old 99/winChance and NOT the frames' 1.9800 placeholder. The 9069-1141 First Roll pill-row fix is in source at DiceGame.tsx:1468 (flex flex-row-reverse ... justify-between), so a partial row anchors right as that frame draws it; it could not be exercised end-to-end here because the dev session has a zero POINTS balance, and it remains confirmed against the 415 settled production rounds already recorded on this row. 9003-44542 Tablet Alt stays DECLINED on the grounds already recorded (it is the mobile composition re-parented into the tablet shell, rivalling the verified 9003-44223 at the identical breakpoint), and nothing this pass changed that call.
